# Plan and Implement

## Change Summary

Reviewed the three pending amendments against the current workspace and confirmed the production paths already satisfy them: shrimp condition uses the same access-adjusted food target as feeding, `PlayerAction::AddShrimp` seeds adults through `receive_entrants()`, and snapshot/TUI parsing accept pre-stage payloads that omit `sub_adult_count` and `total_shrimp_count`. The only follow-up needed in this pass was tightening the shrimp satiation regression so it isolates that access-adjusted food-target contract without failing on incidental chemistry drift, then rerunning focused validation.

## Steps

0. [Completed] Inspect the pending shrimp-condition, AddShrimp, and snapshot compatibility code paths and compare them against the current workspace state.
1. [Completed] Confirm the runtime implementation already covers the three pending amendments and avoid redundant production-code edits where the fixes were already present.
2. [Completed] Tighten the shrimp satiation regression so it verifies access-adjusted satiation directly, while preserving the existing AddShrimp reseeding and legacy snapshot compatibility coverage.
3. [Completed] Run formatting and targeted validation for the touched `tank_core` and `tank_tui` paths.

## Validation Evidence

- `cargo fmt --all` completed.
- An initial `cargo test -p tank_core --lib` run exposed a brittle exact-value assertion in `update_condition_treats_full_accessible_ration_as_satiated`; after tightening that regression, the rerun passed.
- `cargo test -p tank_core --lib` passed (59 tests).
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test validation` passed.
- `cargo test -p tank_tui api_client` passed.

## Outstanding Risks

- Validation stayed focused on `tank_core` unit/validation coverage and `tank_tui` API-client parsing; I did not rerun broader scenario, harness, or full-workspace suites in this pass.
- The repository currently has unrelated unmerged-index entries in `crates/tank_core/src/systems/plant_growth.rs`, `crates/tank_core/src/types/actions.rs`, `crates/tank_core/src/types/habitat.rs`, `crates/tank_core/src/types/state.rs`, and `crates/tank_core/src/types/substrate.rs`; I left those untouched, so broader git operations may still need manual resolution.
